s1.text:
The hallway ahead is wrong. The torches burn, but they cast no shadows. The air is still — too still, like the room itself is holding its breath.

A faint shimmer ripples across the far wall. The Ghost is here, somewhere, watching.

Three doors line the corridor. One hangs open. One is locked. One has scratch marks around the handle.
s1.ascensionText: You've been here before. The shadowless torches, the still air — but this time you can feel it watching you from the moment you step inside. It remembers you.
s1.imagePrompt: A dark corridor with torches that cast no shadows, three doors in a row, one ajar with eerie light, one locked, one with scratch marks, supernatural tension, dark fantasy

choices.text: Slip through the open door — it's inviting for a reason
Force the locked door — whatever's hidden matters
Examine the scratched door — someone was desperate to get in

s2a.text:
The room beyond is a chapel of mirrors. Reflections shift independently of your movement — echoes of the Ghost's presence.

In one mirror, you see a figure standing behind you. When you turn, nothing. But the mirror shows the Ghost's stance: low, coiled, ready to lunge from the left.
s2a.imagePrompt: A dark chapel filled with ornate mirrors, reflections moving independently, a ghostly figure visible in one mirror behind the viewer, supernatural atmosphere, dark fantasy

choices.text: Study every mirror — map the Ghost's attack patterns
Smash the mirrors — deny it hiding spots
You read the reflections like a trail — angles reveal where the Ghost truly stands

s2b.text:
The room is empty. Or so you think.

A cold breath on your neck. You spin — nothing. A whisper from your left. You turn — shadows. The Ghost is toying with you, testing your reflexes.

Your heartbeat is deafening in the silence.
s2b.imagePrompt: An empty dark room with swirling shadows, a faint ghostly breath visible in cold air, tense isolated feeling, supernatural horror, dark fantasy

choices.text: Stand perfectly still — don't give it a reaction
Move fast and unpredictably — match its energy

s2c.text:
Behind the scratched door: a hunter's den. Chains, traps, and a journal — someone tried to catch the Ghost before you.

The journal's last entry reads: "It phases every third strike. Count. Predict. Strike when it returns."

Useful. If you can keep count under pressure.
s2c.imagePrompt: A hunter's den with chains and traps hanging from walls, an open journal on a wooden table, candlelight, notes and diagrams pinned to walls, dark fantasy

choices.text: Study the traps — learn what worked against it
Take a chain — might be useful as a weapon

s3.text:
The arena materializes around you — you didn't walk here, the Ghost brought you. The walls shimmer like heat haze.

Somewhere in this shifting space, the Ghost waits. You can't see it. But you can feel it watching.
s3.imagePrompt: A shifting arena with walls like heat haze, reality distorting at the edges, a faint ghostly silhouette barely visible, supernatural tension, dark fantasy

choices.text: Close your eyes — trust your other senses
Sharpen your reflexes — react faster than it can phase
Stay calm and wait for it to come to you
You sense the phase pattern — strike the exact spot where it will rematerialize

s4_final.text:
A whisper, right in your ear: "You never see them coming."

The air splits. The fight begins.
s4_final.ascensionText: The whisper is different this time. "You came back." A pause. "Brave. Or stupid." The shimmer coalesces faster — the Ghost isn't playing games anymore.
s4_final.imagePrompt: A ghostly shadow stalker materializing from darkness, blurred movement, ethereal energy, the moment before an attack, dark fantasy boss encounter
